assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production-ready ORIGINAL background painting for the small handheld garden defense game. Image 1 is STYLE AND PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY. Match its warm, bright, confident storybook gouache brushwork, soft dark olive line accents, warm yellow-green lawn, mint foliage, pale pink and buttery-yellow flowers. SQUARE composition, entire garden comfortably inside image with breathing room, no elements abruptly sliced by canvas edges. This is an empty background plate, NOT a game screenshot. Main requirement: the central 78% of the width and 70% of the height is one continuous QUIET PLAIN GRASS MEADOW with subtle soft brush texture. Absolutely NO grid, checkerboard, tiles, lanes, squares, platforms, panels, frames, inset picture, rectangles, wooden signs, characters, UI or text. A thin naturally flowing garden perimeter: small leafy canopy and dappled sun at top; a slender curved cobbled footpath on the far left; complete low wildflower tufts and round small stones near the lower corners; right edge a light airy sprinkling of leaves and flowers. Keep these accents delicate and confined near the outer 10-14%, away from the central playable meadow. Do not crop flowers, stones or treetops: all salient silhouettes fully visible inside the canvas; the outside edge may simply continue as soft grass color. Continuous painterly transitions, no cut-and-paste seams or boxed border. The top/bottom/left/right central strips should be simple repeating-compatible grass/foliage textures, because the painting will be used as a nine-slice background with undistorted corners. Draw refined flowing brush textures that still read cleanly when downscaled to 480x480. Cheerful high-quality casual 2D game art, not pixel art, no jagged hard pixels, no photographic or 3D elements. Entirely original, no recognizable characters, UI or scene from any existing commercial game.

Use case: stylized-concept. A SINGLE original tiny menu-selection ornament sprite for a warm hand-painted storybook garden defense game. The ornament is one charming curled fresh mint-green leaf with a small pale yellow dew sparkle on its tip, elegant softly tapered silhouette, dark olive-brown softly painted contour, mint and chartreuse brush texture, delicate soft highlights. Matches the provided game's brush-painted foliage; no fire, no flame, no orange teardrop, no sharp vector icon, no neon/glossy plastic effect. Designed to remain instantly readable at 18x20 pixels: simple beautiful broad leaf silhouette and restrained detail, no thin busy veins. Center the whole ornament with generous transparent margins; complete leaf fully visible, no cropping. Genuine transparent background, no shadow floor, no circle, no text, no frame. Only one isolated sprite, no alternatives or grid.
